name: Cenarion Lunardust
summary: Turak Runetotem gives Cenarion Lunardust to young tauren druids on Thunder Bluff. They use it to awaken Lunaclaw at an ancient Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens.

sections.title: A Rite of Body and Heart
sections.body: Cenarion Lunardust carries the Cenarion Circle’s blessing for druids ready to join the Druids of the Claw. At the Moonkin Stone west of Camp Taurajo, the dust calls Lunaclaw, a sacred beast bound to test each initiate. Defeating the guardian tests strength and resolve. The trial teaches the young druid the strength of body and heart needed to take the form of a bear.

faq.q: What is Cenarion Lunardust used for?
faq.answer: Sprinkle Cenarion Lunardust over the Moonkin Stone in the hills between Mulgore and the Barrens, west of Camp Taurajo. The dust summons Lunaclaw, whom initiates must defeat to prove their strength.
Turak Runetotem, the druid trainer on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, gives the dust to tauren druids undertaking the trial of bear form.

faq.q: What happens if you lose your Cenarion Lunardust?
faq.answer: If you lose the dust or fail against Lunaclaw, return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff for another pouch.

faq.q: Why must a druid face Lunaclaw?
faq.answer: A druid faces Lunaclaw, protector of the stone, to test physical strength and inner resolve. By defeating the beast, an aspiring Druid of the Claw learns the lessons of body and heart needed to wield the Great Bear Spirit’s power.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, you use this dust in the rite of passage that opens the way to bear shapeshifting.
As a tauren, you receive the dust as a young Shu'halo, deepening your bond with the Cenarion Circle’s teachings, nature, and Kalimdor’s wild spirits.
